Your private travel proposal

From Tokyo’s bright lights to Kyoto’s timeless temples

Your adventure begins in vibrant Tokyo, with Shibuya as your base for discovering the city’s colourful neighbourhoods, exciting food scene and immersive art experiences. Then slow the pace in Hakone, where soothing hot springs, mountain scenery and the shores of Lake Ashi offer a relaxing escape. In Kyoto, explore beautiful temples, atmospheric streets and traditional gardens, with time to discover Gion and enjoy a day trip to Nara. Visit Himeji’s magnificent castle before continuing to Hiroshima, where moving history is balanced with the peaceful beauty of nearby Miyajima Island. Your journey finishes in Osaka, with lively neighbourhoods, bustling markets and celebrated street food to savour. Throughout your 14-night stay, carefully chosen hotels and thoughtfully planned transport bring everything together, balancing memorable discoveries with time to relax and make Japan your own.

02Your stayHotels

4 nights · Cerulean Tower Tokyu Hotel, A Pan Pacific Partner Hotel Tokyo-to, Tokyo, Shibuya-ku

Cerulean Tower Tokyu Hotel, A Pan Pacific Partner Hotel

Soaring 40 floors over Shibuya’s city skyline, Cerulean Tower Tokyu Hotel cuts a striking figure as one of the tallest skyscrapers in Tokyo’s famous shopping and entertainment district. Located close to Shibuya station, this Pan Pacific Partner Hotel offers luxurious accommodation with myriad dining and leisure choices under one roof, making it one of the top Shibuya hotels for discerning travellers.

1 nights · Hakone

Ryuguden

Ryuguden is a historic, upscale Japanese ryokan (traditional inn) located on the tranquil shores of Lake Ashi in Hakone, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The large viewing window acts like a living postcard, perfectly framing the calm waters of Lake Ashi (Lake Ashinoko), the lush outer rim of the Hakone crater, and a spectacular backdrop of Mount Fuji

4 nights · Kyoto

THE THOUSAND KYOTO

The Thousand Kyoto features air-conditioned rooms with satellite flat-screen TV in the Shimogyo Ward district of Kyoto. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and room service, along with free WiFi. Private parking is available on site. TKP Garden City Kyoto is 200 metres from The Thousand Kyoto, while Sanjusangen-do Temple is 1.2 km from the property. The nearest airport is Itami Airport, 46 km from the accommodation. This is Kyoto, as it lives and breathes.
